pages.text: --- Page 1 --- DWIGHT DAVID EISENHOWERNI JANGGI TANGANIKO KANDIKE SEGIMIN. KARbEnSON SANgMA. --- Page 3 --- Janapchengani. Dalgipa mingsinggipa ong'na sikgipa manderang, mingsinggipa manderangni gimin porainu aro skie rana namnika.

Foot ball kalna changna sikgiparang changgiparangni gimin w'ie ra'a. Ia agilsako na'a ningsinggipa namgipa dilgipa ong'na sikode ia Dwight Duvid Eisenhowerni Janggi tanganiko chugimik sena manja- haoba nangbatgiparungkode , seaha. Na'a Janggi tangao chusokgipa ong'na sikode iano nangna dakchakaniong'naba gnang.
Saoba ia kitapko namdapatna kupatianirangko onpaode anga milelbegen. --- Page 5 --- Japang Katarang. Poraiani Bak 1.
Bisamiting Salrang. Poraiani Bak 2. Schoolo Poraiani gimin. Poraiani Bak 3.
Sipai kamna poraiani. Poraiani Bak 4. Eurcpe dakgrikani gimin.
Poraiani Rak 5. Day, Europeko ra'na tik ka'ani gimin. Poraiani Bak 6.
Utaha Sagal rikamko ra'ani. Poraiani Bak 7. Sasonni bidingo kam ka'ani aro Janggi tangani.
Poraiani Bk 8. Dwight David Eisen. howerko bonchote salam ka'rikani. Poraiani Bak 9.

22 Pinted at the Don Bosco Press, Tura. --- Page 7 --- Dwight David Eisenhowerni janggi Tanganiko Kandike Seani. "Anga America a'songni bijatchio atchiaha".

Poraiani Bak ! Bi'samitingni Salrang: Dwight David Eisenhower man'e chagipa chugipama'chongoni ongpaja, aro indiba toromigipa nokdangoni 'ong'a. Dwight David Fisenhowerni pagipa David Bisenhower aro uni ma'gipa Ida , ong'achim.

David Eisenhower mechanies kamko ka'gipa onge dingtang dingtang biaprangona reroroe kamrangko ka'na nanga- chim. i880 bilsio ua Texasni songjinmao rail garini engineerango kam ka'engmitingo David Eisenhower 1890~ bilsini October 14  tariko, uamangni para ra'e donggipa noko atchiaha. Ua bisantal been ansenge dalrorogipa ong'aha. Dao noksano pagipaba David depanteba David  ongani _gimin' jamano, ma'gipa una Dwight David Eisenhower ine uko mingdapaha.
Dwight Eisenhowerni atchiani bilsisani jamano, uni pagipa David Eisenhower Kansan songjin- maona re'ange. kamko, ka'eaha. Iano kam ka'engmitingo Kristian dolsako grongaha.

Ua- --- Page 8 --- mangara River Brethren minggipa ongachim. Uamang an'tangtangko Kristoo Jongadarang ine mingachim aro pilak kamo aro olakkiao uamang jongada gitan dakachim. David Eisenhower aro uni nokgimik ia dolo nape toromna gisik nangbatbaaha.
Uamang nokgimik toromni gimin gisik, nangbae dedrangkoba toromo dalatna ma'gipa gisik nangbaaha. David Eisenhowero depante sakdok gnang- chim. Uamango saksaba demechik dongpajaha.

Uni gimin iamang sakdokdepanterangan magipako dakchakna nangaha. Nokni pilak kamrangko iamang saksa sikgipinna nisigrikgija katokaiaha. Songaritaoni, nok' jam taria aro ba'ra kancha suaona kingking iamangkam ka'na nangaha. Pilakan kamna gisik nanggipa.
rang ong'achim. David aro Ida antangmangni dedrang sak. dokkon toromo dalatna joton ka'aha.

Noko toromko skina aro namao sason ka'na gualjaha. Uamangni bimchipe kam ka'ani biteko pagipa ma'gipa nikange kusi ongaha. Uamangni pilak Janggi tanganio pagipa ma'gipani _skia gita choligiparang, ongaha ine, nikgen.

Roy, ua- mangni dejakra. samni gimin Doctor ong'é manderangnadakchakna man'aha. .Arthur, badingchiwalani gimin poraienba Bauk Manager ong'aha. Earl, Engineeringo, poraie, Enggineer ong'aha, Edgar, niamni, gimin, poraie Ukkir ongaha., Milton Educationni gimin poraie, Uni- versityni Vice Chancellor ongaha.

Dwight Eisenhower sascnni gimin poraie sipaini dalgipa --- Page 9 --- an'ching Dwight David Eisenhowerni nokdango Janggi tanganiko kandike uina mangen. Poraiani Bak 2 Schoolo Poraiani gimin : Nokdango obosta namjani gimin name suk gipinranggitaporaina ong'e manpajaha. Dwight Eisenhower bisantal Sunday Schoolna gisik, nanggipa ong'aha.
Ua Schoolo ,poraiao namgipa . aro, gisik nanggipa ong'achim.. Ua Arithmetic, Alzabra aro Geometryko namnikgi- pa ong'achim.

High Schoulo poraimitingo ua history aro Geometryko namnikbataha. Dilgipa, ka'donggipa aro amrikkitgipa manderangni gi- min ua poraina namnikbataha. Jensalo ua High Schoolko matchotaha, jojol, Collegeo poraina manjaha.

Ua antang Edgarko ,porai- atenba antang kam ka'e dakchakna tik ka'aha, maikai Edgar jamano uko dakchakskana man'- gen. , Bilsisuna, kingking Iwight kam ka'beaha. Adita jarangna walprako, ghotna 12 dake kam ka'aha. Antiprako walsnina kingking kam ka'- aha.
Indiba gitik gitak una rosong kopal na- maha. Saliramchipak indin. poraina cholko onenga ine uni ripengrangoni saksa aganeaha.

Ua joljol Senator Joseph L.Brislowna dolgato seataha. Adita antirangni jamana porika ra'ani onggen ine uiatako mansoaha. Uiata gita Dwight Eisenhower adita antini jamano porika --- Page 10 --- seaha.: Ua Anapolisona seanio skanggipa ong- aha.
aro uan Navyni kamna onga'chim. Saii. ramni porikako seanio ua gnigipasan ongaiaha.

gimin ua napna manjaha. Poraiani Bak 3 Sipai Kamna Poraiani : Jensalo Dwight Eisenhower Sipaini kamna seokako man'aha aro poraina abachengaha,.uko banganIke ine sengsote mingbataha. Ua gisik nangbee poraiaha aro jokan salo kal- grikna aro pokar kalaniko kalna namnikaha. Ua skotango tupiko name donna manningjaha, uni gimin adita.
mandapanirangko gimatbeaha. 1915~ bilsio Saliram sipai dolni dilgipa ong'na sak 59 General Rankona seokako manaha. Ikeba ua dolona donatako manpaaha.
Iamang- oni sakgnide Star Rongbongako manjolaiaha. Uamangara Ike aro Bradley ongachim. Pilak porika ra'gipa 164 oni Ike 61 gipa gadangona donatako man'aha.

Sipaini kamo ka'roroani : 1915 bilsio ua Fort Tom Houstono gaigipa Leutennt on'e ka'engmitingo Danveroni saksa : metra, uko grongna reangaha. Uamang sukgnian 'namnikgrike ua apsan bilsini July jao uamang bia ka'aha. Bilsisani jamano Americaba skang- -gipa Dal'gipa dakgrikanio jak on'paaha, Dakgrik-
